card.name: Linking words before bone-health terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces, or partway pieces of drug names in osteoporosis and bone-loss passages, where a bone or fracture term is expected next.

modes.label: Linking words before fracture or bone terms
modes.description: Words like for, of, than or low sit right before a word such as fracture, bone loss or osteoporosis.

modes.description: A space or small word after a number or duration in bone-drug dosing and monitoring text.
